name: LAME_MAN_OF_BETHESDA
canonical: the lame man of Bethesda, an emaciated invalid infirm thirty-eight years, gaunt sun-worn olive skin stretched over thin limbs, a haggard hollow-cheeked bearded face, sparse matted grey-streaked hair, dressed in a threadbare tattered tunic, lying helpless on a rough straw mat
